description: This file defines the class `QueryFilterCriteriaFactory`, which is responsible for creating and managing query filter criteria, parsing filter strings into criteria, and applying namespace restrictions within the Eclipse Ditto project. It provides factory methods and utilities for handling filter criteria based on RQL expressions, and facilitates the creation of criteria objects used for querying.

classes.name: QueryFilterCriteriaFactory
classes.description: Final class providing factory methods for creating and manipulating query filter criteria within the Eclipse Ditto framework. Handles parsing of RQL filter strings, applying namespace restrictions, and providing singleton access to a model-based factory instance.

methods.name: modelBased
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of the model-based QueryFilterCriteriaFactory.

methods.name: filterCriteriaRestrictedByNamespaces
methods.description: Creates a filter criterion from a filter string, restricted to specific namespaces.

methods.name: filterCriteria
methods.description: Creates a criterion from a filter string by parsing it, throwing an exception if invalid.

methods.name: toCriteriaFactory
methods.description: Returns the underlying CriteriaFactory used by this instance.

methods.name: restrictByNamespace
methods.description: Internal method to apply namespace restrictions to a given criteria.

methods.name: mapCriteria
methods.description: Parses a filter string into a Criteria object, handling exceptions and visitor pattern.
